## Objective
- Fix a Discord digest bot bug where messages exceeding 2000 characters fail on retry, causing a cascade failure that prevents busy servers from ever getting a digest
- Implement message chunking to split digests into multiple messages under the length limit while preserving text integrity

## Important Details
- DISCORD_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH = 2000 (per Discord API spec)
- Text is composed of blocks separated by blank lines; blocks that fit in one message are never split
- Block separators at message boundaries belong to neither message
- Over-long lines (> limit chars) are cut into consecutive pieces of exactly limit chars (last holds remainder)
- All non-empty lines must appear exactly once across messages in original order
- The 10-second timeout is required for persistent failure tests (retries back off in real time)
- Only three files to modify: src/services/digest.ts, src/utils/constants.ts, tests/services/digest.test.ts

- Testing runDigest where a chunk persists failing (should leave watermark unchanged)

3. Add additional test coverage for edge cases if needed (empty strings, empty blocks, mixed line lengths)
